decisions.reason: Fair in part. The capture, scan, conversion and card queue were reviewed earlier, but the earlier Results for the model call and the card stage say no review was asked for, and a card run sends text from outside pages to a model. Increment A now has a first step that names each surface, says what was reviewed, asks the owner once and records the answer.

Fair: a sentence about the field left the queries open to being chosen after a result. The plan now lists the twelve exact sentences, written before any run, says which pages count for each field, and says a miss is reported and the sentences are not changed.

Fair: the corpus and report were not named. The plan now names the earlier corpus by its recorded hash, which I checked against the file, requires a hash check before the run, and names a report file that does not exist so the check writes nothing. The path stays out of tracked files, as the project rule asks.
Correct: operations research has four pages and the other three owner fields have three each. The sentence now says so; the total of 30 was right.

The owner chose to keep the Candidate: none line. The plan writes no code and only runs commands the engine already has; the owner directed the batch and the fields; a roadmap for loading sources would need a finish line that cannot be stated precisely today. The plan keeps a note under deferred work that such a roadmap can be written later if the owner wants one.
